curation.system_role: An intermediary who translated between a public buyer, a thin local shell, and an offshore advisory service.
curation.lead: Lina Ortega is the human bridge in the demo investigation. The public record is incomplete, but together a hosted procurement-packet excerpt [DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402693], the hosted governance excerpt [HARBOR-LEDGER-BOARD-MINUTES-2024-11], and the interview-note source record [PORT-WATCH-CALL-NOTES-2025-02-14] place her inside the handoff between Harbor Ledger and Meridian Port Authority.

sections.title: Operating Role
sections.content: Ortega appears as an observer in Harbor Ledger governance materials and as a named coordination contact in reporting notes [Finding #9007, #9006]. That makes her an ideal demo subject for showing how Ithildin separates inspectable artifacts from metadata-only corroboration.

sections.title: Public Footprint
sections.content: Her public footprint is sparse. The strongest inspectable references in the demo sit in hosted packet and registry excerpts [DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402693][REG:FL:L23000214567]. The rest of the trail depends on well-described but non-public reporting notes [Finding #9008, #9009].

open_questions: Did Ortega hold a formal role at Estuary Advisory or only operate as an external fixer?
Were her communications disclosed to Meridian's ethics or procurement compliance staff?

findings.summary: Reporting notes describe Ortega as the person who surfaced Harbor Ledger to Meridian's procurement staff.
findings.detail: This finding anchors the metadata-only source record in a personnel-focused dossier.

evidence.source_quote: Lina was the one who brought Harbor Ledger into the room.

findings.summary: Hosted board minutes show Ortega attending as an observer during the Estuary Advisory addendum discussion.
findings.detail: The example demonstrates a hosted-copy source record with an inspectable artifact.

findings.detail: This is the clearest inspectable artifact tying Ortega to the transaction narrative in the public portfolio demo.

findings.summary: Registry and onboarding evidence place Ortega in the same agent and contact cluster as Harbor Ledger and Estuary Advisory.
